clauses.clause: All six weapons selectable; L6 roster arrives with same ids at full health in formation (no convergence through the courier).
clauses.note: Both actual current native L5/L6 carried saves arrive in L7 with the same23 human IDs at full health. Across600 initial ticks per tier (13800 relative-motion capsule samples), minimum courier/follower surface clearance is+0.063778m, with independent controls identical. Both shared-pool headless Metal WebGL2 physical runs collect the launcher by moving approach, then actually select bat/axe/handgun/shotgun/MG/rocket with Digit2/3/4/6/5/7 and read back all6 correct selections. Eight listed before/after frames personally reviewed at both qualities and zoom0.5/1.5 show the staggered formation behind the courier. Courier protection is explicit only in the physical selection capability run; no actor/arsenal/position edits or route completion claim.
